evidence: AIP is our generative artificial intelligence (AI) platform, which provides secure connectivity to third-party-provided large language models (LLMs), a development toolchain for building AI-powered agents and automations, an array of AI-enabled end user applications
AIP enables responsible AI-advantage across the enterprise and government by using primary, core components built to effectively activate LLMs and other AI within any organization
AIP uniquely allows users to connect LLMs and other AI with their data and operations to facilitate decision-making within the legal, ethical, and security constraints that they require
AIP is seamlessly bundled with existing Palantir offerings such as the Foundry, Gotham, and Apollo platforms

The Ontology has continuously evolved over time, serving as the heart of our platforms by activating data and analytics inside operations, enabling real-time connectivity between data, analytics, and operational teams, as well as AI
ai_positioning.summary: Palantir se positionne comme intégrateur d'IA générative via sa plateforme AIP, qui connecte les LLMs tiers aux données et opérations des clients plutôt que de développer ses propres modèles. L'IA est intégrée transversalement dans son écosystème de plateformes (Foundry, Gotham, Apollo) avec un accent sur la gouvernance responsable et la sécurité.
